$comment: Signature-verified desktop updates. Merged over tauri.conf.json at build
only when a public key is available.
It is a separate file precisely so the absence of a key is a build that
cannot update, rather than a build that updates without checking. There is
no third state: with this config the app verifies every byte against
`pubkey` before running it, and without it the app has no installer at all
and only links to the release page.
`pubkey` is written here by CI from the TAURI_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY variable.
The placeholder below is not a key and will not verify anything -- that is
deliberate, so a build that forgot to substitute it fails closed instead of
trusting an attacker who knows the placeholder's private half.
See docs/desktop-update-signing.md for generating the key pair.
